y-m-54-05.title: Zvakanaka here kuwedzera mativi ose maviri ne x?
y-m-54-05.topic: Mamiriro ekutarisa usati wawedzera ne variable mu fractional inequality
y-m-54-05.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa kumhedziso x<3 yakawanikwa nekuwedzera mativi ose maviri e 6/x>2 ne x, uye unyore zvakare mhinduro kuratidza kuti nzira yechiratidzo che inequality inoenderana nechiratidzo che x.
y-m-54-05.material: Jiho akanyora izvi achigadzirisa inequality 6/x > 2 (x ndi real number isiri 0). “Kana ndikawedzera mativi ose maviri ne x, 6 > 2x, saka x < 3. Saka x=-1 inewo mhinduro.” 6/x inoverengwa se '6 over x.'
y-m-54-05.prereq.0: Basa iri rinofungidzira kugoverwa kwekuoma (H2) kwe 'high school Basic Math 1 track' uye harioneki kuti zvirimo zvinodzidzwa pagiredhi ripi (marongerwo echikoro anosiyana). Linear inequalities pa middle school level (kuwedzera ne negative number kunodzosera chiratidzo che inequality) nekuverenga makosha e fractional expressions.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.prompt: Tinoda kutarisa kana mhedziso yaJiho 'kana x<3 saka 6/x>2' yakarurama. Sarudza chinhu chakakodzera chekutanga kuita.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa makosha ane x<3 kuita positive ne negative, uye usarudze maviri kana matatu eimwe neimwe.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.1: Isa kukosha kwega kwega mu 6/x uye urange mutafura kana kuri kukuru kana kudiki kupfuura 2.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.a: Wedzera mativi ose maviri ne2 uye utarise kana ma expressions anova akaenzana
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.a: Expression itsva yakagadzirwa nekuwedzera mativi ose maviri nenhamba imwe chete haina hukama hwakananga nekuti mhedziso yekutanga yakarurama kana kuti kwete.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.b: Isa x=3 uye utarise kana mativi maviri akaenzana
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.b: Kutarisa kukosha kwemuganhu chete hakuedzi x<3 yose.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.c: Paradzanisa 6/x ne x kuti upfupise expression
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.c: Izvo zvinoita expression kuva yakaoma zvakanyanya uye hazvisi chiito chinoedza mhedziso.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.d: Isa makosha mashoma ane x<3 mu inequality yekutanga
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.d: Iyi inzira inoedza zvakananga dzimwe dzenyaya dzinotaurwa nemhedziso.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.explain: Chirevo che 'kana x<3 inogara ichishanda' chinoputswa kana kunyange kukosha kumwe chete kune x<3 kusingaite kuti inequality ishande. Kuisa zvakananga mu inequality yekutanga 6/x>2 ndiyo nzira yakananga zvikuru.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.prompt: Isa ma integers 2 akasiyana x apo mhedziso yaJiho x<3 inoshanda asi inequality yekutanga 6/x>2 isingashande. (x ndi integer kubva ku-50 kusvika ku50, uye x haisi 0)
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa integer imwe negative neimwe positive ine x<3 mu 6/x.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana 6/x iri hombe kupfuura 2 pamwe chete nechiratidzo chayo.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.ok.c1: x ndi integer mukati merenji, isiri 0.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva integer isiri 0 kubva ku-50 kusvika ku50.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.ok.c3: 6/x iri 2 kana pasi, saka inequality yekutanga haishande.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c3: 6/x yakakura kupfuura 2, saka inequality yekutanga inoshanda. Haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.explain: Kana x=-1, saka 6/x=-6, uye -6 haina kukura kupfuura 2. Kunyange ne x<3 pane makosha asingashande, saka mhedziso yaJiho haina kururama. Makosha aya ose ndema negative.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.prompt: Gadzirisa mhinduro yaJiho. Nyora pamwe chete kuti dambudziko raiva papi uye renji remhinduro yakawanikwa zvakarurama.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvakaparadzana expression yaunowana nekuwedzera mativi ose maviri ne x kana x iri positive nekana x iri negative.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana x=-1 yakasanganisirwa kana wakabatanidza mhedzisiro yenyaya mbiri.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakafunga uchiparadzanisa nyaya apo x iri positive nenyaya apo x iri negative here?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza nzira yechiratidzo che inequality zvakaparadzana munyaya imwe neimwe here?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa here kuti renji remhinduro yako haripo x=-1, yakanganisika naJiho?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.0: Dambudziko ndere kuti wakawedzera ne x usingazivi chiratidzo che x. Kana x iri negative, nzira yechiratidzo che inequality inodzoserwa. Kana x>0 chete inova 6>2x, saka mhinduro ndi 0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.1: Kana x>0, saka 6>2x, saka 0<x<3. Kana x<0, chiratidzo che inequality chinodzoserwa kuita 6<2x, ndiko kuti x>3, asi izvo hazvifukidzani ne x<0, saka hapana mhinduro. Saka mhinduro ndi 0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakaverengawo zvakaparadzana nyaya negative uye yakaratidza kuti hapana mhinduro.

y-m-54-03.title: Kana tikachinja k, mhinduro dzinochinja sei?
y-m-54-03.topic: Huwandu hwe real roots dze quadratic equation x²-4x+k=0, ne k dzinopa integer roots
y-m-54-03.goal: Ona kuti huwandu hwe real roots dze quadratic equation ine letter k hunochinja sei ne k, gadzira iwe pachako makosha e k anopa integer roots mbiri dzakasiyana, uye utsanangure mutemo.
y-m-54-03.material: Mu equation x²-4x+k=0, k ndi integer, uye mhinduro dzinoongororwa pakati pe real numbers. Kana ukachinja k, huwandu nechimiro chemhinduro zvinochinja. Subin akasarudza kutsvaga mhinduro achichinja k kuita 0, 3, 4, 5, -1. x²-4x+k inoverengwa se 'x squared minus 4x plus k.'
y-m-54-03.thinking.0: Kuisa makosha e k nekuenzanisa huwandu hwe roots

y-m-54-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza k dzose dzine mhinduro dzakasiyana mbiri dziri real. (k ndiyo constant term ye equation iri pamusoro)

y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.c: Pamwe wakafunga kuti k inokura, mhinduro dzinowedzera. Mu equation x²-4x+5=0, tarisa kuti (x-2)² yaifanira kuva kukosha kupi.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.e: Hauna kusiya chokwadi chekuti k negative inogonawo kuva nemhinduro.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.explain: Sezvo x²-4x+k=(x-2)²+k-4, tinowana (x-2)²=4-k. Kana 4-k>0, ndiko kuti k<4, pane mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana; kana k=4 pane mhinduro imwe; uye kana k>4 hapana real solutions.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.prompt: Isa ma integers k 3 apo x²-4x+k=0 ine ma integers maviri akasiyana semhinduro. (k ndi integer -60 kana kupfuura, uye mhinduro ndema integers maviri akasiyana pakati pe real numbers)

y-m-54-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza ma integers maviri ane sum iyoyo, uatore semhinduro mbiri, uye uverenge kuti k inova chii.

y-m-54-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana k iri 4 kana kupfuura, mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana hadzibudi.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Mhinduro mbiri dzinobuda seema integers chaizvo.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Mhinduro hadzisi ma integers. Tsvaga chimiro chemhinduro zvakananga uye utarise.

y-m-54-02.title: Kupatsanura kwaHarin: kunogara kuri kwakanaka here?
y-m-54-02.topic: Huwandu hwemhinduro dze linear equation ine mavara mu coefficient
y-m-54-02.goal: Dzidza kuti huwandu hwemhinduro dze equation sa (a-2)x=b-3 hunochinja ne a ne b, tonga kuti chii chaunofanira kuziva usati wataura mhinduro, uye ugadzire iwe pachako a ne b dzinoenderana nemamiriro.
y-m-54-02.material: Pane equation (a-2)x = b-3 mu x. a ne b i nhamba (ma constants) dzine mitengo isati yasarudzwa. Harin akati, “Kana ukapatsanura mativi ese ne a-2, unowana x=(b-3)/(a-2), saka nguva dzose pane mhinduro imwe,” uye Ujin akati, “Inogona kuchinja zvichienderana ne a.” (a-2)x inoverengwa 'a minus 2, times x.'
y-m-54-02.prereq.0: Basa iri rinofungidzira kugoverwa kwekunetsa (H2) kwe 'high school Basic Math 1 track' uye harirevi kuti zvirimo zvinodzidzwa kugiredhi rei (zvirongwa zvezvikoro zvinosiyana). Kugadzirisa ma linear equations epadanho re middle school nechokwadi chekuti 'haugone kupatsanura ne 0.'
y-m-54-02.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kutaura mhinduro ye equation iyi semutengo mumwe usingazivi mitengo ye a ne b. Sarudza chinhu chakakodzera zvikuru chaunofanira kuziva zvakawanda.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mitengo sa 3 ne 2 pa a imwe panguva uye unyore kuti equation inochinja sei.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana pane chikonzero chemamiriro enhamba kana uchipatsanura mativi ese nenhamba imwechete.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.a: Zvakakwana kuziva kana b i 3 chete
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.a: Kana ukaisa b=3 rutivi rwekurudyi runova 0, asi mhedziso inochinja zvakare zvichienderana nekuti coefficient yekuruboshwe i 0 here.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.b: Tinofanira kuziva kana a-2 i 0 kana kwete
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.b: Uri kuona kuti mamiriro enhamba yaunopatsanura nayo anogona kupatsanura mhedziso.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.c: Zvakakwana kuziva chete kuti a ne b zvose ndema integers
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.c: Hunhu hwekuva integer hahukanganisi huwandu hwemhinduro. Kana a=2, inewo integer.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.d: Zvakakwana kuziva chete kana x iri positive
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.d: Kuziva chiratidzo che x kuri kure neruzivo runoparadzanisa huwandu hwemhinduro. Tarisa divi re coefficient.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.explain: Kana coefficient a-2 ye x isiri 0, unogona kuparadzanisa uye pane mhinduro imwe. Kana a-2=0, equation inova 0·x=b-3, uye kana b-3 iri 0 pane mhinduro dzisingaperi, uye kana zvisina hapana mhinduro. Saka unofanira kuziva kana a-2 iri 0.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza ma integers a ne b kuti equation (a-2)x = b-3 isave nemhinduro zvachose, uye uise mienzaniso 2 yakasiyana. (a ne b ndema integers kubva ku-20 kusvika ku20)
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa 2 se a kuti divi rekuruboshwe rive riri nyore, uye utarise kana rinopa kukosha kumwe chete pasinei ne x yaunoisa.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.1: Paradzanisa kuita nyaya apo divi rekurudyi b-3 riri 0 nenyaya apo risiri 0, uye uise kukosha kumwe kwe x zvakananga.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana coefficient a-2 ye x isiri 0, pane mhinduro imwe.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.ok.c3: 0·x yakaenzana nenhamba isiri 0, saka hapana mhinduro.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana divi rekurudyi riri 0, pane mhinduro dzisingaperi. Edza kuita kuti divi rekurudyi rive nhamba isiri 0.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.explain: Kana a=2, divi rekuruboshwe ndi0·x=0, saka kana divi rekurudyi b-3 riri nhamba isiri 0, hapana x yaunoisa inoshanda, saka hapana mhinduro. Kana b=3, x yose ndiyo mhinduro. Kana a isiri 2, pane mhinduro imwe chete.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yekutumira kuna Harin. Nyora kuti munyaya ipi 'pane mhinduro imwe nguva dzose' yaHarin isingashande uye kuti chii chinoitika kumhinduro munyaya iyoyo.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti 'nhamba yaunoparadzanisa nayo' mukuverenga kwaHarin inogona kutora kukosha kupi.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga a inoita kuti kukosha uko kuve 0 uye unyore kuti equation inova nechimiro chipi ipapo.

y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana a iri 2, saka a-2 ndi0, saka haugoni kuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri nayo. Ipapo inova 0·x=b-3, saka kana b isiri 3 hapana mhinduro, uye kana b iri 3 x yose ndiyo mhinduro. Kana a isiri 2 chete pane mhinduro imwe, x=(b-3)/(a-2).
y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.1: Tisati taparadzanisa, tinofanira kutarisa kana a=2. Kana a=2 waizoparadzanisa ne0, izvo zvisingabvumirwi, uye ipapo kana b=3 pane mhinduro dzisingaperi uye kana b isiri 3 hapana mhinduro. Kana a isiri 2, pane mhinduro imwe sezvakataurwa naHarin.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kurongeka kwekuparadzanisa kuita nyaya kwakasiyana chete, uye zvirimo zvakafanana.

y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isa makosha maviri rimwe nerimwe mu equation yekutanga |x-1|=2x uye uverenge mativi ose maviri.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka mhinduro ndi x=-1 kana x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.4: Aya ndiwo makosha maviri akawanikwa nekugadzirisa, saka ose mhinduro dze equation iyi.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 4 ne5. Mukuita kugadzirisa, hapana chivimbiso chekuti mhinduro dze expressions dzenyaya dzakaparadzaniswa dzinova mhinduro dze equation yekutanga. Kana ukaisa x=-1 mu equation yekutanga, divi rekuruboshwe ndi |-2|=2 uye divi rekurudyi ndi 2×(-1)=-2, ayo anosiyana. Kune x=1/3, divi rekuruboshwe ndi2/3 uye divi rekurudyi ndi2/3, anofanana.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukaisa x=-1 mu equation yekutanga, divi rekuruboshwe ndi |-1-1|=2 uye divi rekurudyi ndi 2×(-1)=-2. Sarudza chinhu chakakodzera zvakanyanya kutaura kubva pamhedzisiro iyi.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti kukosha kudiki kunogona kutorwa nedivi rekuruboshwe |x-1| ndekupi.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.1: Shanda kana equation inogona kushanda murenji re x apo divi rekurudyi 2x riri negative.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.a: |x-1| iri 0 kana kupfuura asi 2x iri negative, saka hazvikodzeri
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.a: Uku kufunga kunotanga nekutarisa renji remakosha anogona kutorwa nedivi rimwe re equation.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.b: Nekuda kwe absolute value, nhamba dzine zviratidzo zvakasiyana dzinogona kuonekwa senhamba imwe chete, saka iyi inewo mhinduro
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.b: Absolute value inobvisa chiratidzo kudivi rekuruboshwe chete. Haina simba padivi rekurudyi 2x.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.c: Pakanga paine kukanganisa kuverenga, uye kana ukagadzirisa zvakare makosha ose maviri mhinduro
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukatiza kukanganisa kunyange kuverenga kwakaiswa kwakarurama, pamwe hauvimbi mhedzisiro yawakatarisa.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.d: x=-1 mhinduro uye x=1/3 haisi mhinduro
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.d: Pamwe wakasarudza imwe chete nenhevedzano usina kuisa makosha ose maviri kuti utarise. Isawo 1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.explain: |x-1| inogara iri 0 kana kupfuura, saka 2x inofanirawo kuva 0 kana kupfuura. Kune x=-1, 2x iri negative, saka haikodzeri, uye kune x=1/3 mativi ose maviri ndi2/3. Saka mhinduro yega ndi x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.prompt: Panzvimbo penzira yaSeoa, nyora imwe nzira inoratidza kuti x=1/3 ndiyo mhinduro yega. Semuenzaniso: tara renji re x kutanga, kana kuparadzanisa kuita x≥1 ne x<1. Nyorawo kuti nei x=-1 isiri mhinduro.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa x=-1 mumativi ose maviri e equation yekutanga uye uenzanise zviratidzo.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti absolute value inogona kuva makosha api sekushoma, uye unyore kuti mamiriro api akaiswa ku expression yekurudyi.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Unogona kutsanangura kwandinoisa 'chikonzero chekusefa mhinduro' zvakasiyana nenzira yaSeoa here?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa nekuisa mu equation yekutanga kuti x=1/3 inyatsova mhinduro here?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Chikonzero chekurasa x=-1 chakajeka here, kana nerenji kana nekuisa?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.0: |x-1| iri 0 kana kupfuura, saka 2x inofanira kuva 0 kana kupfuura, saka x≥0. Ipapo x=-1 inorasirwa uye x=1/3 chete inosara. Kana ukaisa 1/3, mativi ose maviri akaenzana ne2/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana x≥1, x-1=2x inopa x=-1, asi iyo haisi x≥1, saka haishande. Kana x<1, 1-x=2x inopa x=1/3, inogutsa x<1. Saka mhinduro yega ndi x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakasvika kumhedziso imwe chete nenzira yekuparadzanisa renji.

y-m-54-09.title: Tinogona kusvika kupi nekukosha kuri mutebhura chete?
y-m-54-09.topic: Kufungidzira mhinduro dzeinequalities f(x)<0 ne f(x)≤0 kubva patebhura nemamiriro equadratic function
y-m-54-09.goal: Kana pane tebhura yekukosha kwefunction chete, siyanisa zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi nezvekwakaita f(x)<0, uye teedzera kuti mhinduro inosarudzwa sei sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera uye kuti musiyano pakati pe < ne ≤ unoonekwa sei mumhinduro.
y-m-54-09.material: Pane quadratic function f(x). Coefficient ye x² mu f(x) yakanaka, saka girafu ine chimiro che U. Kukosha kwe f(x) kunoratidzwa nhanho nenhanho. f(-2) inoverengwa 'f of negative 2.'
y-m-54-09.prereq.0: Basa iri rinofungidzira kugoverwa kwekuoma (H2) kwe 'high school Basic Math 1 track' uye hariratidzi kuti zvirimo zvinodzidzwa mugiredhi ripi (marongerwo echikoro anosiyana). Chimiro chequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (chimiro che U kana a>0), kuverenga kukosha kwefunction, nezvekutanga zvefactoring.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.prompt: Verenga ruzivo rwunozivikanwa uye usarudze kufungidzira nezve x dzinoita f(x)<0. Unogona kuchengeta kana kuchinja kufungidzira kwekutanga.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maka kukosha kwega kwega mutebhura kana kuri kwakanaka, 0, kana kusina, uye ufungidzire kwakakwira chimiro che U kumusoro.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.hint.1: Nguva imwe neimwe apo ruzivo rutsva rwunouya, ongorora zvakare kana zvawakataura kuti zvechokwadi kare zvichiri zvakarurama.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kutaura chii zvechokwadi zvino nezve x dzinoita f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=-3<0, saka x=0 yakasanganisirwa zvechokwadi. Chimiro i U uye f(-2) ne f(4) zvakanaka, saka x ine f(x)<0 inogona kuva pakati pe -2 ne 4 chete. Asi hatisati taziva miganhu chaiyo. 'c' ne 'd' zvose zviri zvokwadi zvakasiyana zvinogona kutaurwa zvechokwadi zvino.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: X yega inosangana na f(x)<0 ndi 0
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatora mapoinzi apo kukosha kwakatariswa chete semhinduro. Hatisati taziva kukosha pakati pemapoinzi, asi tinogona kushandisa chimiro che U.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakagumisa kuti zvose zviri mukati zvine negative nokungoona kuti kukosha kwemigumo kuri pamusoro. Hatisati taziva kukosha pakati pa 0 ne -2.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kana paine x dzinosangana na f(x)<0, dzose dziri pakati pa -2 ne 4
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa inoshandisa chimiro che U nezviratidzo zvekukosha kwemigumo pamwe chete.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unofungei pamusoro pemhando ye x inosangana na f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Muchimiro che U, f ndi 0 pa -1 ne 3, saka ine negative pakati pazvo uye iri pamusoro kunze. f(x)<0 inoreva 'shoma pa 0,' saka migumo -1 ne 3 haisanganisirwi, zvichipa -1<x<3. Hapapikisani ne x=0, yawakati yaiva yechokwadi pachikamu chapfuura, iri mukati memhando iyi.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatarisa nguva yenegative nenguva iri pamusoro yechimiro che U nenzira yakapesana. Tarisa kana inowirirana na f(0)=-3.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kunyange wakaona kuti f ndi 0 pamigumo -1 ne 3, wakazviisa pasi pemamiriro okuti 'shoma pa 0.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatora mapoinzi apo f iri 0 chete semhinduro. Mapoinzi aya haasi kukosha kuri pasi pe 0.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Mamiriro akachinja. Basa iri ndi f(x)=x²-2x-3. (Unogona kutarisa nokuverenga zvakananga kuti rinowirirana nekukosha kwose kuri patafura.) Ikozvino mubvunzo ndewemhando ye x apo f(x)≤0, ndiko kuti, 'iri 0 kana pasi.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Unofungei pamusoro pemhando ye x inosangana na f(x)≤0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.after: f(-1)=0 ne f(3)=0 zviri 0 kana pasi zvakare, saka migumo inosanganisirwa, zvichipa -1≤x≤3. Kana chiratidzo chokusaenzana chichichinja kubva ku < kuenda ku ≤, kukosha kwomuganho kunopinda mumhinduro.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hauna kuratidza kuti ≤ inosanganisira 'kuenzana.' Tarisa kuti f(-1) ne f(3) ndei.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakaona ≤, wakachinja kuva nguva dziri kunze. Tarisa kana f(0)=-3 iri 0 kana pasi.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakatora poinzi yakasimbiswa chete semhinduro. Kukosha kuri mukati kwose kuri 0 kana pasi here?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.reflect: Kubva pakukosha kushoma patafura, unogona kuparadzanisa 'zvakasimbiswa (chiratidzo chekukosha kwebasa, mhando inowanikwa kubva pachimiro che U)' ne 'zvichiri zvisingazivikanwi (migumo chaiyo),' uye sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera, mhando yakasimbiswa inodzikira.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.prompt: Iyi ndiyo mhinduro yaSeungu yakawana mhinduro ya f(x)<0 kana f(x)=x²-2x-3. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakanganisa. (Mitsetse inoverengwa kubva pa 1.)
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x=-3 mumhedzisiro yomutsetse 4, x<3, uye uverenge kana kusaenzana kwekutanga f(x)<0 kuchishanda.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.1: Rongedza patafura kuti zviratidzo zvipi zvinopa chakawanikwa chiri negative.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.2: Chakawanikwa chiri negative, saka x+1<0 kana x-3<0.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.3: Saka x<-1 kana x<3, ndiko kuti, x<3.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 3 (nomutsetse 4, unobva pawo) ndiwo une dambudziko. Kuti chakawanikwa chive negative, zviratidzo zvezvinhu zviviri zvinofanira kusiyana. Kana ukati 'chimwe chazvo chine negative,' unosanganisira nyaya apo zvinhu zvose zviviri zvine negative, uye wobva wava chakawanikwa chiri pamusoro. Semuenzaniso, kana x=-3, saka (-2)(-6)=12, iri pamusoro. Mhinduro chaiyo ndi -1<x<3. (Kusarudza mutsetse 3 kana mutsetse 4 zvose zvinogamuchirwa sezvakarurama.)
